items.title: Middleware execution order
items.text: Middleware hooks into request/response processing. Keep it focused, order it correctly, and ensure it returns a response when it short-circuits the request.

content_blocks.title: Worked example: Understanding Django Middleware
content_blocks.code:
def request_id_middleware(get_response):
    def middleware(request):
        request.request_id = "demo-id"  # use a real per-request strategy in production
        response = get_response(request)
        response["X-Request-ID"] = request.request_id
        return response
    return middleware
content_blocks.expected_output: The middleware attaches a request attribute and adds a response header while preserving the response object.
